paper_title: Persistent Gut Microbiota Immaturity in Malnourished Bangladeshi Children

pico.outcome: severe acute malnutrition (SAM) is associated with immature gut microbiota. Even after therapeutic food interventions, the gut microbiota of malnourished children did not fully mature.

supplement: Intervention_period_day is expressed as average values. The exact value is 1.3±0.7 weeks. collection_timing_day changes the unit from months to days.other_ index:weight gain rate,WHZ score
